changeSet.author: Sebastian Abraham
changeSet.sql: merge CompanyResource as T using ( select ID as CompanyID, 0 as ResourceID, 0 as IsAdministrator from Company ) as S on (S.CompanyID = T.CompanyID and S.ResourceID = T.ResourceID) when not matched by target then insert (CompanyID, ResourceID, IsAdministrator) values (S.CompanyID, S.ResourceID, S.IsAdministrator);
